mau: dung 160 anh xu_ly == to_xam trong mau 320 anh cua R48B (tieu_chi_cong_bo.json khoa mau_yolo, seed 48): chon lai bang dung thu tuc phan_yolo cua src/kc48/audit_du_lieu.py va doi chieu tung (split, video, anh) voi results/phase2/kc48_audit/yolo_kiem_mau.csv; lech -> dung, khong tinh
giai_ma: PIL Image.open(...).convert('RGB') cho ca anh goc va anh xuat; uint8; so cung kich thuoc

vung.raster: hinh chu nhat px [floor(y1):ceil(y2), floor(x1):ceil(x2)] sau khi cat vao khung; box < 1 px bo qua
vung.V: hop vung to_xam (crowd thuoc 5 lop, other vehicle, trailer)
vung.G: V tru hop box co nhan -> ky vong (114,114,114)
vung.K: V giao hop box co nhan -> ky vong giu nguyen anh goc (doi tuong co nhan khong bi xoa)
vung.O: ngoai V -> ky vong giu nguyen anh goc
vung.loi: G_loi: pixel G co cua so (2r+1)^2 (cat theo khung) toan G; O_loi / K_loi: pixel O / K co cua so khong chua pixel G. r = 8 px = mot khoi DCT 8x8; bien JPEG (ringing, chroma 4:2:0) nam trong dai nay, va quy uoc raster floor/ceil o bien khong anh huong phan loi

ly_do_dung_sai: exporter ghi JPEG chat luong 95 bang cv2 (src/bdd_yolo_export.py:574); bang luong tu hoa o q95 = 10 % bang chuan (buoc 1-12), khoi 8x8 phang 114 giu DC gan dung; 6 muc chua chenh lech bo giai ma (cv2 luc ghi, PIL luc kiem) va lam tron YCbCr<->RGB

chi_so.ti_le_xam: so pixel xap_xi_xam / so pixel vung
chi_so.mae: trung binh |I_ra - I_goc| tren moi kenh moi pixel cua vung (thang 0-255)
chi_so.psnr_db: 10 log10(255^2 / MSE), MSE tren moi kenh moi pixel cua vung; MSE = 0 -> inf

nguong.T1_vung_to: G_loi khac rong va ti_le_xam(I_ra, G_loi) >= 0.99
nguong.T3_box_chong_vung: neu K_loi khac rong: psnr_db >= 35 va mae <= 2.0; K_loi rong -> khong_ap_dung
nguong.ket_qua_anh: dat = T1 dat va T2 dat va T3 in {dat, khong_ap_dung}; khong_dat = co tieu chi khong dat; chua_ket_luan = G_loi rong (vung qua mong de tach khoi bien JPEG) va khong tieu chi nao khong dat

bao_cao_them_khong_nguong: ti_le_xam(I_goc, G_loi): doi chung - anh goc da xam san o vung nay thi T1 khong phan biet duoc
ti_le_xam(I_ra, G), mae / psnr tren O, K day du (gom dai bien)
ti_le_xam tren K (anh ra va anh goc), so box co nhan cham V
sha256 anh xuat so voi manifest; vung tai suy so voi file ignore (dung sai 0.006 px, nhu R48B)
